dataset_name: Kiburan Addis Ababa Wedding Marketplace Test Data
purpose: Development and UI testing only. Not production vendor data.
important_data_rules: All prices are illustrative test prices, not verified vendor quotes.
verified is false for every record. Do not display a verified badge from this dataset.
Some hotel names are listed in venue directories but do not have confirmed wedding packages.
Outdoor facilities are reported or unconfirmed unless explicitly stated. Confirm with each venue.
Records marked synthetic_demo are fictional and must not be represented as real businesses.
Replace test prices and unverified records after contacting businesses and obtaining consent.
